latest.title: Geometric regularity for semi-convex viscosity solutions to the special Lagrangian equation
latest.abstract: We prove that the gradient graph of any $W^{2,1}$ semi-convex viscosity solution to the three-dimensional subcritical special Lagrangian equation is area-minimizing and smooth. Furthermore, we prove the smoothness of $W^{2,1}\cap C^{1,1/3+}$ semi-convex viscosity solutions. This yields progress on the conjecture proposed by Wang--Yuan [WY13]. The corresponding results in higher dimensions are also established.
latest.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
latest.workSummary: 证明三维次临界特殊 Lagrangian 方程半凸 W2,1 黏性解的梯度图光滑且面积极小，并给出附加正则下解光滑。
latest.breakthrough: 推进 Wang–Yuan 正则性问题。
latest.limitations: 图光滑与原函数光滑不同，后者有额外 Hölder 条件。 已补读所列正文片段；这不是逐行独立证明审查。
latest.aiEvidence: 正文披露 GPT 协助证明严谨化、定位 Colesanti 等参考文献及语言润色。
latest.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/html/2609.07458v1（AI 声明/致谢；涉及摘要者同时核对元数据）
latest.priorityReason: 非线性几何 PDE 正则性核心方向。
